title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-ethan-brooks-2026-03-15
content:
SDR Daily Scratchpad - Ethan Brooks - 2026-03-15
------------------------------------------------
Today: focus on top accounts + follow-ups for demo week. Quick wins: finish follow-ups for Warm > Demo-booked, push 3 new discovery calls, reconnect with 2 churn-risk POCs.

Top priorities
1) Book demos for Acme BI, NovaRetail, and AeronHealth (aim for next Tue/Wed)
2) Follow-up with Demo prospects from last week (personalize + share short ROI snippet)
3) Update stage notes in CRM and add next-step calendar invites

AM Block (9:00 - 11:30) - Cold outreach + initial dials
- 9:00 Acme BI | Contact: Priya Mehta (Head of Data) | Reason: latency/cost on batch embedding jobs | Notes: Found mention of "slow nightly jobs" on their blog. Ask about current embedding provider + monthly token volume | Script: quick hook -> "we help teams cut per-token cost by batching + KV cache for partial histories" -> ask for 15-min call next Tue
- 9:25 NovaRetail | Contact: Miguel Torres (CTO) | Reason: improving site search relevance with embeddings | Notes: LinkedIn msg sent 3/10, high intent; call goal = discovery
- 9:50 BrightBank | Contact: Serena Cole (AI Platform) | Reason: compliance + VPC requirement for consumer data | Notes: likely enterprise, escalate to AE if positive
- 10:20 AeronHealth | Contact: Dr. Laura Kim (Dir, ML Ops) | Reason: on-prem inference + HIPAA concerns | Notes: share private deployment doc, ask about audit logs
- 11:00 Follow-ups: quick emails to 3 warm leads (template below)

PM Block (13:30 - 17:00) - Warm follow-ups + pipeline hygiene
- 13:30 Acme BI follow-up (left voicemail 3/12) — leave meeting link + ROI one-pager
- 14:00 NovaRetail — send tailored search example + ask to schedule demo
- 15:00 Internal: update SDR board, move leads with no response to 2nd-touch sequence
- 16:00 Prep materials for demo kit (latency/cost slides + 1-pager on Dedicated)

Call/Email outcomes tracker (quick bullets to paste in CRM)
- Acme BI: tried ring, voicemail left 2026-03-15 09:05 PT — next step: email w/ KPI one-pager (E) — due 2026-03-15
- NovaRetail: connected 2026-03-15 09:28 PT — interested, requested 30-min demo — next step: send calendar invite for 2026-03-17 10:00 PT (assigned)
- BrightBank: no answer — add to ISV track, follow-up in 3 days
- AeronHealth: intro email sent with private-deploy attachments — awaiting reply

Follow-up sequences (short templates)
- Warm follow-up email (use for demo-requested / engaged):
  Subject: Quick demo + ROI example for [Company]
  Body: Hi [Name],
  Thanks for the chat earlier — attached a 1-pager showing how Redwood Inference reduced per-token cost by ~30% for a retailer with heavy embedding workloads. Would 30 mins on 3/17 at 10am PT work for a short demo?
  Cheers,
  Ethan

- 2nd-touch cold email:
  Subject: quick question re: search relevance at [Company]
  Body: Hi [Name],
  Noticed your team is working on improving search relevance. We help teams get faster, cheaper embedding inference via batching + KV cache — often reduces infra costs while improving throughput. Any chance to share your current provider? 10 mins this week?

Pipeline notes / risk flags
- Acme BI: high upside but long procurement cycle — tag as "enterprise-long"
- NovaRetail: strong technical champion (Miguel) — highest priority this week
- BrightBank: requires compliance checklist — loop in AE / security if call connects

Tasks / TODO
- [ ] Send Acme BI KPI one-pager (E) — due EOD 2026-03-15
- [x] Update NovaRetail contact info in CRM (done 2026-03-14)
- [ ] Create demo invite for NovaRetail (assigned)
- [ ] Attach private deployment compliance doc for AeronHealth
- [ ] Add BrightBank to enterprise nurture sequence

Notes to self / reminders
- Keep email snippets <150 words; include 1 concrete ROI bullet
- For enterprise prospects, always ask about procurement timeline and security contacts
- Use Redwood Console screenshots when sharing latency numbers (screenshots in GDrive > shared_drives/product/console-and-rollouts/demo-assets)

Chatter / links
- Confluence playbook: INF-Playbooks/Outbound-Templates (linked_artifacts above)
- Slack threads: #sdr-team (pin NovaRetail convo)

Quick research (to paste into outreach)
- Acme BI: blog post "Scaling embeddings for analytics" (2025-11) -> cite ~2k monthly queries
- NovaRetail: uses Elastic + experiments with dense retrieval (good fit)

End-of-day quick recap (to paste in Monday standup)
- Booked 1 demo (NovaRetail) for 3/17
- Left VM + sent one-pager to Acme BI; awaiting reply
- Prepped private-deploy docs for AeronHealth

Misc scratch thoughts (notes-to-self)
- Ask AE about pricing levers for mid-market retailers — need packaged bullets
- Make 1-slide "how caching reduces token count" for next week deck
summary: SDR daily scratchpad with call list, follow-ups, templates, pipeline notes, and tasks for outbound outreach on 2026-03-15.
